S06_A01_IN_PLACE_INTRO.phrase: Now, we use only the original matrix. Think of the matrix as layers.
S06_A01_IN_PLACE_INTRO.note: 5x5 Matrix enters center stage. Single buffer constraint established.

S06_A02_LAYER_BREAKDOWN.phrase: For our 5 by 5 matrix, the outside border is the first layer. Inside that, the 3 by 3 border is the second layer, and the center is left alone.
S06_A02_LAYER_BREAKDOWN.note: Concentric rings highlighted: Outer 5x5 (16 cells), Inner 3x3 (8 cells), Center (1 cell).

S06_A03_OUTER_CYCLE1_FOCUS.phrase: Let's begin. With the outer layer, the first four connected positions contain top, 1, right, 5, bottom, 25, left, 21.
S06_A03_OUTER_CYCLE1_FOCUS.note: Outer Layer Cycle 1 corners: 1, 5, 25, 21 light up.

S06_A04_ROTATION_DIRECTION.phrase: For clockwise rotation, top must go to right, right must go to bottom, bottom must go to left, and left must go to top.
S06_A04_ROTATION_DIRECTION.note: Clockwise directional flow arrows connecting corners.

S06_A05_OVERWRITE_HAZARD.phrase: But we cannot write top into right first, because we would destroy the old right value.
S06_A05_OVERWRITE_HAZARD.note: Hazard warning: Writing 1 directly into (0,4) destroys 5.

S06_A06_SAVE_TOP.phrase: So save the top value. Save 1.
S06_A06_SAVE_TOP.note: top_val = matrix[0][0] = 1 saved into memory variable.

S06_A07_MOVE_LEFT_TO_TOP.phrase: Now move 21 from left into top,

S06_A08_MOVE_BOTTOM_TO_LEFT.phrase: then move 25 from bottom into left,

S06_A09_MOVE_RIGHT_TO_BOTTOM.phrase: then move 5 from right into bottom.

S06_A10_MOVE_TEMP_TO_RIGHT.phrase: And finally, move the save value, 1, into right.

S06_A11_OUTER_CYCLE1_COMPLETE.phrase: The first four -position cycle is complete. The four corners are now in their final rotated positions.

S06_A12_OUTER_CYCLE2_STEP.phrase: Move one position to the right along the top edge. The next connected values are 2, 10, 24, 16.

S06_A13_OUTER_CYCLE2_EXECUTE.phrase: Save 2, 16 moves from left into top. 24 moves from bottom into left. 10 moves from right into bottom. And save 2 moves into right. Second cycle complete.

S06_A14_OUTER_CYCLE3_STEP.phrase: Move one more position. Now the connected values are 3, 15, 23, 11.

S06_A15_OUTER_CYCLE3_EXECUTE.phrase: Save 3, 11 moves into top. 23 moves into left. 15 moves into bottom. And save 3 moves into right. Third cycle complete.

S06_A16_OUTER_CYCLE4_STEP.phrase: One final cycle for the outer layer. The connected values are 4, 20, 22, 6.

S06_A17_OUTER_CYCLE4_EXECUTE.phrase: Save 4, 6 moves into top. 22 moves into left. 20 moves into bottom. And save 4 moves into right.

S06_A18_OUTER_LAYER_COMPLETE.phrase: Now the entire outer layer is complete. Every value on this border is already in its final rotated position. So we do not touch this layer again.
S06_A18_OUTER_LAYER_COMPLETE.note: All 16 outer border cells glow Green and lock.

S06_A19_INNER_LAYER_INTRO.phrase: Now move one layer inward. The inner layer is a 3 by 3 border. Its first connected values are 7, 9, 19, 17.
S06_A19_INNER_LAYER_INTRO.note: Inward transition: layer=1 (bounds top=1, bottom=3, left=1, right=3). Corners: 7, 9, 19, 17 highlighted.

S06_A20_INNER_CYCLE1_EXECUTE.phrase: Save 7, 17 moves into top. 19 moves into left. 9 moves into bottom. And save 7 moves into right. First inner cycle complete.

S06_A21_INNER_CYCLE2_STEP.phrase: Now the final four position cycle. The values are 8, 14, 18, 12.
S06_A21_INNER_CYCLE2_STEP.note: Inner Cycle 2 offset i=1: positions (1,2)=8, (2,3)=14, (3,2)=18, (2,1)=12 highlighted.

S06_A22_INNER_CYCLE2_EXECUTE.phrase: Save 8, 12 moves into top. 18 moves into left. 14 moves into bottom. And save 8 moves into right. The inner layer is now complete.
S06_A22_INNER_CYCLE2_EXECUTE.note: Inner Cycle 2 executed: top_val=8, 12->(1,2), 18->(2,1), 14->(3,2), saved 8->(2,3). Inner ring complete!

S06_A23_CENTER_ELEMENT.phrase: And 13. The center value was never part of any four position cycle. So it remained exactly where it started.
S06_A23_CENTER_ELEMENT.note: Center element (2,2)=13 highlighted. 1x1 core has no cycles, stays unchanged.

S06_A24_FULL_ROTATION_VERIFICATION.phrase: The entire matrix has now been rotated 90 degrees clockwise without creating another matrix.
S06_A24_FULL_ROTATION_VERIFICATION.note: Full matrix verified: all 25 values match rotated result in-place.

S06_A25_ALGORITHM_SUMMARY.phrase: The pattern is finish one four position cycle safely, continue across the layer, finish the complete layer, then move inward.
S06_A25_ALGORITHM_SUMMARY.note: Summary of Concentric Rings algorithm & loop structure.

S06_A26_CODE_HANDOFF.phrase: Now let's translate that exact movement into code.
